name: SmoothFollowCamera
src_typeComment: Drop on a Camera (or any transform) and assign a target — works for both 2D and 3D since it's just an offset + smoothed follow. For 2D, set the offset's Z to your camera's usual distance and turn lockZPosition on so gameplay depth never drifts (most 2D targets never move in Z anyway, so it's usually harmless either way — but for a 3D chase cam, lockZPosition freezes the camera's depth as the target moves toward/away from it, which is rarely what you want, hence it defaults off).

src_serialized.name: offset
src_serialized.tooltip: World-space offset maintained from the target (e.g. 0,5,-10 for a 3D chase cam, or 0,0,-10 for 2D).

src_serialized.name: followSharpness
src_serialized.tooltip: Higher = snappier follow, lower = more lag/smoothing.

src_serialized.name: lockZPosition
src_serialized.tooltip: Keeps this transform's Z fixed at the offset's Z regardless of the target's Z. Turn on for 2D; leave off for a 3D chase cam.

src_members.sig: public void SetTarget(Transform newTarget) => target = newTarget
